# USCIS Issues New Public Charge Guidance Ahead of September 2026 Rule Changes

USCIS has released extensive new policy guidance explaining how officers will determine whether an applicant for lawful permanent residence is likely to become a public charge. The guidance follows DHS’s rescission of the 2022 public charge rule and will take effect on September 18, 2026. It applies to Forms I-485 postmarked or electronically filed on or after that date.
